condition.narrative: Institutional Arrangements (Hainan)PA, Schedule, Section I.A.1: For the purpose of carrying out its Respective Part of Project,the Project Implementing Entity shall maintain, and cause to be maintained, the following entities with composition, powers,functions, staffing, facilities and other resources acceptable to the Bank:(a) the Provincial Project Management Officeresponsible for the coordination, planning, reporting, management, including management of the fiduciary, environmental and socialaspects, implementation, and monitoring and evaluation of activities under the Project Implementing Entity's Respective Part of theProject and coordination with the Borrower and the Bank; (b) an implementation unit within each of the provincial departmentssupporting the Provincial Project Management Office in the implementation of the Project Implementing Entity's Respective Part ofthe Project, including preparation of the Annual Work Plans and Multi-Sectoral Plans, semi-annual progress and financial reports,and day-to-day implementation of the activities within their jurisdiction under the Project Implementing Entity's Respective Partof the Project, including management of the fiduciary, environmental and social aspects(c) a technical expert group responsiblefor providing technical support to enhance quality in the design of activities under and facilitate implementation of the ProjectImplementing Entity's Respective Part of the Project; and(d) any other implementation structures at the provincial, municipal orcounty level, as may be agreed from time to time with the Bank and set out in the Project Operations Manual.

Institutional Arrangements (Jiangxi)PA, Schedule, Section I.A.1: For the purpose of carrying out its Respective Part of Project,the Project Implementing Entity shall maintain, and cause to be maintained, the following entities with composition, powers,functions, staffing, facilities and other resources acceptable to the Bank:(a) the Provincial Project Management Officeresponsible for the coordination, planning, reporting, management, including management of the fiduciary, environmental and socialaspects, implementation, and monitoring and evaluation of its respective activities, including the preparation of the Annual WorkPlans and the Multi-Sectoral Plans; and the Provincial Project Management Office within its Provincial Health Commissionresponsible for overall coordination, consolidated planning, reporting, and monitoring and evaluation of the activities under theProject Implementing Entity's Respective Part of the Project and coordination with the Borrower and the Bank; (b) a technicalexpert group responsible for providing technical support to enhance quality in the design of activities under and facilitateimplementation of the Project Implementing Entity's Respective Part of the Project; and(c) any other implementation structures atthe provincial, municipal or county level, as may be agreed from time to time with the Bank and set out in the Project OperationsManual.

title.narrative: Guidelines reflecting One Health approaches for cross-border inspection and quarantine systems for animal and plant products in Hainan developed and implemented

Cross-sectoral management mechanism for One Health established in Hainan and meeting regularly
Quality of surveillance system improved in selected project counties

target.value: The divergence between the surveillance system and the independent serological surveys in selected project counties has reduced. The final target percentage will be determined after the first year of project implementation.
